items.title: 8.1 Introduction to Online Research and Digital Literacy (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Yeh chapter online research aur digital literacy batata hai: advanced search ke tareeqon se online tehqeeq, digital wasail ka intezam, wazeh research sawal banana, research ethics aur intellectual property ke huqooq, ta ke students mazboot, akhlaqi tehqeeq kar sakein aur digital mawad durust istemal karein.

blocks.title: Online research
blocks.text: Online research internet par articles, reports aur videos jaise maakhaz se kisi mauzoo ki maloomat dhoondna hai, jis ka maqsad durust, qabil-e-bharosa aur taaza maloomat jama karna hai jo mauzoo samajhne ya masla hal karne mein madad de.
Jaanchein ke maloomat motabar maakhaz, jaise sarkari websites, taleemi idare ya maaruf akhbarat, se hai, aur nataij ki durustagi ke liye kai maakhaz milayein.

blocks.prompt: Online mili maloomat ke motabar hone ka yaqeen kaise karein (short question 1)?
blocks.explanation: Sarkari, taleemi ya maaruf khabron ki sites jaise motabar maakhaz istemal karein; dekhein kis ne aur kab likha; aur bharose se pehle kai doosre maakhaz se milayein.

items: Online research: durust, qabil-e-bharosa, taaza maloomat dhoondna; maakhaz jaanchna aur milana.
